itinerary.title: Welcome to your Srinagar base
itinerary.description: Transfer to the agreed stay and allow time to settle in. Discuss the purpose of your visit, walking comfort, dietary preferences and any observance you hope to attend. The coordinator checks visiting arrangements before the sightseeing days; a late arrival is kept free of compulsory stops.

itinerary.title: Chatti Padshahi and Srinagar context
itinerary.description: Visit Chatti Padshahi in Srinagar near the Hari Parbat area, following the gurdwara’s current visitor guidance. Allow time to understand the site’s Sikh heritage without treating the prayer space as a photo stop. If you wish to join langar or seva, ask the management what is appropriate and available; participation is not a prepaid package activity.
places: A short surrounding heritage walk if desired
experiences: A respectful gurdwara visit with head covered and shoes removed as directed
Optional langar or seva only with the management’s guidance

itinerary.title: A dedicated Baramulla gurdwara day
itinerary.description: Give Baramulla its own return outing. The Chatti Padshahi gurdwara here is a different site from the Srinagar gurdwara of the same name. Confirm the meeting point and visit with local management before departure, and keep the road day focused rather than adding another distant district. Allow a planned meal break and return buffer.
experiences: Time for the gurdwara visit and local context
A considered road outing with rest breaks

itinerary.title: Mattan Sahib and the southern valley
itinerary.place: Srinagar · Gurdwara Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Mattan · Srinagar
itinerary.description: Travel south for a separate visit to Mattan Sahib, associated with Guru Nanak Dev Ji in Sikh tradition. Confirm the gurdwara’s current arrangements and leave space for reflection. Nearby temple and spring surroundings can be an optional heritage discussion for interested guests, with permission, rather than a compulsory multi-faith circuit.

experiences: A planned lunch and return journey

itinerary.title: Leave time for the onward journey
itinerary.description: Have breakfast if departure timing permits, then take the agreed transfer. Airport and road buffers come before any extra visit. An early flight may require leaving before breakfast service; confirm this and any packed food with the stay. Additional shrines or outlying sites need a revised itinerary rather than a last-minute detour.
